Name: Asher's Black Orpington Chickens - Void Chicken Replacement
Author: ashercusack
Description: This mod replaces your standard void chickens with less spooky, more fuzzy black Orpingtons - one of the most popular domestic chicken breeds. You can also use the sprite sheet file to add it manually yourself as a separate animal or a replacement for another chicken.

Manifest.Name: Asher's Black Orpington Chicken
Manifest.Description: A CP replacement for void chickens
